params.prompt: Age of the Lost (AOTL) game zone master painting: the sprawling multi-tiered royal city of Crownsfall, seen from the game camera: a fixed 31-degree three-quarter overhead view, the same angle and scale as the plaza painting reference, uniform across the whole image, no horizon and no sky (this is a playable map). The layout follows the plan reference exactly, 3 x 3 districts. CENTRE: the existing Bluebanner Square plaza exactly as in the plaza painting reference (compass-star mosaic, statue fountain at its upper right, blue and red market awnings at its top edge, grand stairs at its upper left, balustrades with banners and lamps). TOP ROW (highest tier, raised on tall ivory retaining walls): top-left Pilgrim's Rise with the great Gothic cathedral, spires and stained glass; top-centre the Upper Citadel Approach with a royal manor and an archive hall and a broad road leaving the top edge toward the citadel; top-right Citadel Falls, a great waterfall pouring from the citadel cliffs into a basin. MIDDLE ROW (plaza level): left the Westgarden Terraces, stepped gardens with gazebos, fountains and little rills; right the Royal Market with striped awnings, stalls, the merchant guild hall and canal bridges. BOTTOM ROW (lower tier): bottom-left Bellfound Ward, a bell tower and homes along a canal with small falls between quays; bottom-centre the Gate District with guard barracks and the great main city gates where the road leaves the bottom edge; bottom-right the Lantern Quays, a river basin with arched bridges and floating glowing lanterns. Grand stone stairways connect the tiers; waterfalls cascade down the tier walls into turquoise canals; a magical feel: softly glowing runes in the stonework, floating lanterns, golden light motes. Streets, squares and stairs are wide open paved areas, clearly readable as walkable paths linking every district. Hand-painted painterly fantasy matching the references: warm ivory limestone, royal blue and gold heraldic banners, blue slate roofs, gilded trim, ivy and purple wisteria, white and blue flowers, warm morning sunlight from the upper left. No characters, no people, no text, no labels, no UI, no border.
